title: Partner handoff brief - Lena (scratchpad)
notes:
Objective: quick, actionable handoff for channel partner ops -> product/support for cross-cloud marketplace listing (AWS + GCP + Azure). Use this during 1:1 with Marcus and the subsequent partner sync. This is a working checklist — messy, intentional.

Meeting goals (10-15m):
- Confirm ownership of each operational area (who does what next 2 weeks).
- Align on minimal launch requirements per cloud + blockers.
- Flag items that need legal/compliance review before public listing.
- Agree on 3 tracking metrics (first 2 weeks): install conversions, failed installs by region, billing reconciliation errors.

Agenda draft (for 1:1 + quick sync):
1) TL;DR status (30s each): Marcus (partner side), Lena (product-side)
2) Cloud readiness snapshot (AWS / GCP / Azure) — 1 min per cloud
   - AWS: listing metadata done, Marketplace contract signed? check PROD-4123.
   - GCP: pricing SKU mapping pending (PR /registry#89), need PM approval for tier names.
   - Azure: onboarding pipeline failing on ARM template validation in eastus2.
3) Security / infra blockers (3 min)
   - KMS key provisioning for private deployment images (partner asks HSM integration)
   - VPC peering checklist: docs link in confluence + network contact (Rajiv)
4) Legal/compliance quick flags (1 min)
   - Data residency statement needs confirmation for EU regions.
   - Customer data handling section: does listing require explicit Private Offer?
5) Follow-ups & owners (2-3 min)

Quick status notes (raw):
- AWS: metadata draft in drive; partner requested alternative pricing units (vCPU vs token) — need finance opinion (Priya). Ticket PROD-4231 created.
- GCP: marketplace SKU schema mismatch with our internal billing; Marcus to push PR to registry with corrected sku_ids.
- Azure: ARM template validator error: missing subscription-level permission; counsel with infra-eng (SRE team) to add service principal instructions.

Action items (rough + owners + target):
- Marcus: push updated SKU mapping for GCP to repo and link PR -> target 2026-01-22 (blocked by finance input).
- Lena: draft short customer-facing blurb for listing (focus on private options and dedicated latency SLA) -> 2026-01-21.
- Priya: confirm pricing unit guidance (vCPU vs token) and provide recommendation -> 2026-01-24.
- Rajiv (network): verify VPC peering steps for Azure eastus2 and provide required IAM roles -> 2026-01-26.
- Legal (cc: Maya): quick check on EU data residency clause; flag if Private Offer required -> 2026-01-28.
- SRE (cc: Tomas): quick runbook on ARM template permission error; sample service-principal creation snippet -> 2026-01-25.

Notes-to-self (Lena):
- Keep follow-ups tight: prefer 1 slack thread per cloud to avoid cross-thread noise.
- Ask Marcus to prioritize GCP SKU PR — it is the gating item for billing tests.
- Capture acceptance criteria for "listing ready" for each cloud (minimal checklist below).

Minimal listing-ready acceptance criteria (draft):
- Listing metadata complete (icons, descriptions, support contact) -> ✅/owner
- Billing SKU mapping validated against internal ledger -> test payments pass in sandbox
- Region availability confirmed and documented -> list of enabled regions
- Deployment templates validated (ARM/Terraform/CloudFormation) -> CI passes
- Security/compliance notes present (KMS, VPC, data residency) -> Legal signed off
- Observability hooks in place (metrics export endpoints + basic dashboard) -> SRE validated
- Support routing: defined escalation path + pager on-call contact in listing -> support confirmed

Parking lot / questions to surface in partner forum:
- Do channel partners want per-customer private offers (more admin overhead) or a single marketplace SKU? pros/cons to draft for Marcus.
- How to represent quantized model variants vs full precision in listing? separate SKUs or variants in same listing?
- Auto-upgrade policy for customers: do we allow automatic minor-version bumps or require manual upgrade? implications for rollback.

Dependencies / cross-references:
- PROD-4123 (AWS listing contract) — action: confirm contract execution date
- PROD-4231 (pricing debate) — needs finance input
- registry PR #89 — GCP sku updates (link in linked_artifacts)
- Confluence page: marketplace-listing-guidelines (linked): use section "cloud-specific templates"

Follow-up messages to draft after meeting (templates):
- Short summary for partner: bullets: who owns what + dates + immediate blocker (e.g., GCP sku). Keep < 6 bullets.
- Internal ask to SRE/infra: subject line "Azure ARM template blocker — action needed by 01/25". Include minimal reproduction steps and desired outcome.

Risk table (quick):
- High: Billing mismatch -> could delay GA -> mitigation: sandbox billing test this week, escalate to finance.
- Medium: ARM template permission -> mitigation: provide SP creation snippet + temp elevated run.
- Low: Listing copy turnaround -> mitigation: I will draft base copy today.

Meeting prep checklist (what to bring):
- Link to PRs / tickets pinned in slack thread
- One-pager (2 paragraphs) describing why private deployment option matters to early partners (for partner comms) -> draft done by Lena (see notes above)
- Quick demo screenshot of console listing mock (if Marcus asks)

Micro decisions I can make now (no approvals):
- Approve minor wording on listing copy for tone.
- Fast-track ARM runbook once SRE confirms no security risk.

Where I expect blockers:
- Finance availability for pricing callouts (Priya overloaded next week).
- Legal review queue (Maya flagged slow turnaround). Consider asking for 24-hour quick-check escalation.

Next 1:1 agenda items to bring if needed:
- Post-handoff: initial install funnel metrics after first 100 installs (3-week check-in).
- Customer questions triage template for partner support.

Random notes / brain dump (keep) :
- Consider offering a short "managed onboarding" SKU for first 5 customers to reduce friction — premium price, higher margin.
- Check whether Dedicated capacity needs separate SKU or can be option toggled post-install.
- If partner demands HSM-level integration for KMS, outline cost + security tradeoffs in a one-pager.

Summary (to paste into slack after meeting):
- "Quick recap: owners + dates: Marcus -> GCP SKU PR (1/22); Priya -> pricing rec (1/24); Rajiv -> VPC steps (1/26); Lena -> listing blurb (1/21); SRE -> ARM fix (1/25). Main blocker: GCP SKU/billing. Posting follow-up tickets now."
